summary: A failed captured write leaves a stale CDC transaction ID after rollback, allowing a subsequent empty COMMIT to emit a spurious CDC record and historically panic without an active MVCC transaction. The fix resets the ID on transaction rollback, establishes a transaction before CDC commit-record writes, and rejects OpenWrite without an MVCC transaction. The exact reversal below removes the rollback reset. Blocked: the added test, functions::test_cdc::test_cdc_mvcc_failed_insert_then_empty_commit, performs an intervening SELECT whose successful autocommit halt resets the stale ID, masking this reversal. No other detecting upstream Rust test was established. No builds or tests were run.
